description: This file defines functions for managing GitHub project entities such as listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting projects and project items. It includes schema definitions, error handling, and interaction with the GitHub API via the go-github client library.

methods.name: ListProjects
methods.description: Lists projects for a user or organization based on provided parameters.

methods.name: GetProject
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific project for a user or organization.

methods.name: ListProjectFields
methods.description: Lists project fields for a user or organization.

methods.name: GetProjectField
methods.description: Retrieves a specific project field for a user or organization.

methods.name: ListProjectItems
methods.description: Lists project items with optional filtering and pagination.

methods.name: AddProjectItem
methods.description: Adds a new project item to a project.

methods.name: DeleteProjectItem
methods.description: Deletes a project item from a project.

methods.name: toNewProjectType
methods.description: Converts a string to the corresponding project type used in API calls.

methods.name: validateAndConvertToInt64
methods.description: Validates and converts a value to int64.

methods.name: buildUpdateProjectItem
methods.description: Builds the payload for updating a project item from input map.

methods.name: extractPaginationOptionsFromArgs
methods.description: Extracts pagination options from argument map.
